findings.description: User-supplied strings are directly embedded into SVG output without any sanitization or escaping.
No validation on integer parameters could lead to resource exhaustion.
The `filename` parameter is used directly without validation, potentially allowing directory traversal attacks.
File operations are not properly checked for failures after opening.
